description: EMBERTRACE AI is a research-driven team passionate about Artificial Intelligence, space science and innovation. Our goal is to explore NASA’s microgravity combustion research data and use AI-powered analysis to uncover meaningful patterns and insights. We welcome motivated participants interested in AI, machine learning, software development, data science and scientific research. Let’s turn space data into discoveries!
summary:
EMBERTRACE AI is an AI-assisted research analysis prototype designed to explore NASA research on spacecraft fire safety, combustion and microgravity.

The system analyses NASA research records using keyword-based topic identification and relevance scoring. It categorises research into topics such as Fire Safety, Combustion, Flame Behaviour, Microgravity, Fire Detection and Heat Transfer.

Its interactive dashboard provides research insights, detects topics with limited or no matches in the collected dataset, recommends areas for further exploration and compares research papers using shared topics, keywords and relevance scores.

EMBERTRACE AI aims to make space fire-safety research easier to explore and understand.
details:
EMBERTRACE AI – AI-Assisted NASA Fire Research Analysis

I developed EMBERTRACE AI to make it easier to explore and understand NASA research related to fire safety in space. I was interested in how fire behaves in spacecraft, especially under microgravity conditions, and wanted to create something that could help organise and analyse related research.

The system collects NASA research records and analyses them using keyword-based text analysis and relevance scoring. It identifies topics such as fire safety, combustion, flame behaviour, microgravity, fire detection and heat transfer.

I also created an interactive dashboard using Python and Streamlit. It allows users to explore research topics, view charts, discover areas with limited research records in the collected dataset, and compare two research papers based on their topics, keywords and relevance scores.

I believe this project can make exploring space fire-safety research more organised and accessible. It may also help users notice topics that could be explored further.

I built the project individually using Python, Streamlit, Plotly and JSON in Visual Studio Code. No additional hardware was needed.

One thing that makes EMBERTRACE AI different is that it brings several research-analysis features together in one platform. While developing it, I considered the availability of NASA research data, the relevance of the results and how easy the dashboard would be to use.

The current version uses rule-based keyword analysis rather than a trained machine-learning model, so its results are intended to support research exploration, not replace expert judgement.

Source Code of Embertrace Ai : https://github.com/shasvinmohan-tech/EMBERTRACE-AI.git
